caption: The drawing depicts a pair of light-colored, possibly off-white or beige, knitted socks laid flat against a plain background. One sock is positioned fully extended with the heel, foot, toe, and shaft clearly visible, oriented so the foot points to the right. The other sock is placed behind and slightly inside the first one, showing only the shaft and opening, with the foot portion obscured. Both socks feature a ribbed texture running vertically along their length, and the ribbing pattern is carefully rendered to show fine detail. The drawing uses soft, delicate lines and subtle shading to suggest the knit structure and slight variations in the yarn. The background is an unadorned, light neutral color without additional elements, keeping the focus entirely on the socks.
title: Stockings
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
